fit_on: Reddit MH validation split (v1 out-of-sample), tested on the v1 test split
note: Lexicon features add no accuracy over v1 on Reddit (v1 already uses those words), so text_logit carries almost all weight. They stay in the output to explain the score. Gemini content features (mood, energy_self, anhedonia, social_contact) get weight 0 until the real Gemini call replaces the stub.
feature_stats_source: pooled within-author SD of good-day diaries in ml/text/diary_bank.csv (team-written, 3 authors) – prior for robust_stats, STATUS.md B34
